row.evidence: Brandwatch's SSO article says "Admins are responsible for manually configuring SSO for any new users added to the organization after SSO is enabled"; neither public help centre returns any article for "scim" or "provisioning".
row.notes: New row. Brandwatch (a Cision company) sells Consumer Intelligence (Consumer Research, Vizia), Social Media Management and Influencer Marketing on quote-only 'standard to enterprise' plans; no prices or plan names are published, so team and SSO plan are null. SAML and OpenID Connect SSO are set up with Brandwatch Support; users are created and deleted manually by admins. No SCIM in either public help centre (searches for scim and provisioning return nothing), the developer hub index or the Okta catalogue (SWA app only). Some Consumer Research help articles require a login. APIs: the Consumer Research API exposes only the current user/client (read-only), and the Social Media Management Team API lists team users; SMM API access is arranged and priced through the Account Manager. 'None' is by absence (rule 5).
